output.description: A hearty pasta dish made with a rich tomato sauce from canned tomatoes and tomato paste, flavored with onion and garlic, and finished with grated Parmesan cheese.

steps.headline: Chop onion and garlic
steps.instruction: Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic cloves.

steps.headline: Cook the pasta
steps.instruction: Cook 200 g pasta in salted boiling water according to the package instructions until al dente. Reserve 100 ml of pasta water, then drain the pasta.

steps.headline: Sauté onion and garlic
steps.instruction: Heat 15 ml olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 minutes until translucent. Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.

steps.headline: Make tomato sauce
steps.instruction: Add 400 g canned tomatoes and 20 g tomato paste to the pan. Stir well, bring to a simmer, and cook for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

steps.headline: Combine pasta and sauce
steps.instruction: Add the drained pasta to the tomato sauce. Toss well to coat. If needed, add some of the reserved pasta water to adjust the consistency.

steps.headline: Serve with parmesan
steps.instruction: Divide the pasta between two plates. Grate 30 g parmesan over each serving.
